desc: Derive an exact affine GF(2) characterization of valid local configurations for A and B tiles.
Reduce toroidal horizontal/vertical propagation to even-A parity requirements for every row and column.
Derive explicit propagated seed equations and B-cell parity labels with a consistent prefix convention.
Implement and validate labeled bipartite XOR constraint solving, including inconsistent cycles and isolated row/column vertices.
Produce the final O(HW) Python stdin/stdout solution and verify it against the samples and edge cases.
